configuration.derivation: Subtract-only projection of the approved oss-source capture. Account lookup, interaction rows, media rows over the existing SQLite store, membership/moderation rows, and the invite/channel/forum source rows are carried verbatim; every other registration is named in projection.dropped.

sourceConfiguration.derivation: Offline FastMCP registration/schema harness: `uv sync --frozen --no-dev` then imports telegram_mcp.runtime and telegram_mcp.tools and calls runtime.mcp.list_tools(). The pinned uv.lock fixes dependencies; TELEGRAM_API_ID=1, TELEGRAM_API_HASH=offline, and a local session name allow import-time client construction only. No Telegram credentials are present and no tool is called, so the harness makes no Telegram connection.
